Commentary.Commentary: We are set! David Wiese and Gerhard Erasmus have walked out as the openers for Namibia. A surprise to all as Bilal Khan will bowl the super over for Oman instead of Mehran Khan who looked unplayable today.
... SUPER OVER ...

CAN YOU BELIEVE IT? WE WILL HAVE A SUPER OVER! What a game we have just witnessed here. Oman were down and out at the interval but will now feel that they should have won it on the final delivery. Namibia will be relieved a touch as they have managed to scrape to level terms after a sluggish batting display. It will now be Namibia to bat first as we head into the Super Over. Will we see another close affair in the upcoming one-over shootout? Let's find out.

BYE! OH DEAR ME! Naseem Khushi has spilled a chance to win a historic game for his side. Mehran Khan bowls a brilliant delivery on a length outside off, David Wiese looks to cut this one but misses. The keeper misses it as well and the ball deflects behind him and the batters cross for one. Naseem Khushi did look to run out Malan Kruger but he missed the stumps at the strikers end.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 19.6: Mehran Khan to David Wiese, Bye.

Commentary.Commentary: The stumps probably saves a boundary as this was thumped powerfully by David Wiese. Pitched up in middle, David Wiese hammers this back past the bowler but strikes ths stumps on the other end. The ball deflects off the stumps towards deep cover and the batters come back for two. Super over on the horizon.
